about: rr-vfx-lighting effect presets. Roblox property names, typed values; schema in references/presets.md. Colours: @bible.key tokens, $name from fx_colours, or #FFFFFF/#000000. Offsets and vectors are studs in the anchor's space (Y up, train forward +X). Generated Luau: vfx.py build.

steam_grey.why: steam tail as it thins; a light level of white steam, no palette grey is this light

rain_grey.why: rain streaks; neutral cool grey kept out of the blue-sky band (cab glass #BFD9E6 sits in it)

dust_cream.why: dust kicked off the cinder verge and ballast by the carriage split (shock skirt, wreck landing): a pale warm cream that reads over the verge and the grass (critic pass 1, F2-2; the asked ~#CFC3A2 is in the sepia/desert band, so the hue moved about 6 deg toward yellow)

torn_grey.why: thin smoke off the torn carriage end: a mid-grey lighter than the navy roof and darker than the sky, so it reads against both (critic pass 1, F3-1 asked ~#6E726C; a little darker so the column reads on the pale sky at phone rates)

stand.about: preview test stand only (not the game's geometry): anchors in Roblox studs, rail top y=0, forward +X, right +Z; a component may be an expression over the canon envelope: gauge, width, roof, floor (tech.units.*, OQ-030)

near_camera.about: which preview camera sees an anchor best (players' views: tech.camera.*)

debris_smoke.use: soot trail on flung debris (slapstick arcs); only on parts that move

split_streak.use: streak on carriage-split debris: orange head cooling to soot grey, thin and short (mission variant; debris_smoke and debris_spark stay as shipped for derail and boiler)

steam_chimney.use: chimney steam; rate follows Speed (idle to gameplay.speed.fast)

smoke_chimney.use: coal smoke mixed into the steam; darker, fewer, slower puffs; rate follows Speed

steam_valve.use: pressure safety valve open: loud white jet; the pressure crisis signal

sparks_powerbox.use: electrics down: irregular crackle of sparks and a flash from the power box

sparks_axle.use: axle sparks breakdown: a steady spray thrown out past the body side and back along the rail

coal_dust.use: one shovel into the firebox: dust puff, embers and a firebox flare

firebox_glow.use: firebox light with the flicker canon asked for, plus a few rising embers

headlamp.use: loco headlamp for tunnels and night: spot light plus a soft beam cone (glow colour style.thumb.glow; tunnel and night use proposed)

glass_burst.use: window smash: glinting shards outward and down

derail_explosion.use: slapstick derail burst: flash, fire core, soot cloud, dust, sparks, flung debris. Unassigned until OQ-028
derail_explosion.canon: none: OQ-028 default A keeps derailment a breakdown task; this preset is unassigned

boiler_burst.use: boiler explosion hard fail: steam blast, black soot puff, sparks, flung brass and iron (the YOU'RE FIRED stamp is UI, not here)

rain.use: rain over the train; streaks slant back with GlobalWind at train speed. Shelved until OQ-027
rain.canon: none: no weather canon; OQ-027 default A shelves it

sparks_brake.use: brakes on (station arrival, pressure-crisis brake): fans of sparks thrown out past both body sides and back from the loco wheels, plus a ground glow; rate and glow follow Speed so they die as the train stops. Effect proposed: canon has the brake, not brake sparks

split_explosion.use: carriage split: big slapstick burst in the tear (flash, 6-puff fireball cooling to charcoal in place, 6 round soot puffs rising about 12 studs/s, flat cream shock dust, chunks and hot bits on orange streaks); owner decision 2026-09-29 (C10 'I want a big explosion aswell') overrides the OQ-028 default for the carriage split only
split_explosion.canon: none: owner decision 2026-09-29 (C10 'I want a big explosion aswell') overrides the OQ-028 default for the carriage split only; proposed

torn_edge_smoke.use: carriage split aftermath: thin mid-grey smoke along the kept half's torn end (roof edge and both wall tops from one box), a few orange embers and an ember glow; attach on the snap, fade out after ~20 s
torn_edge_smoke.canon: none: mission 260929-train-splits R3 (torn ends read as torn); proposed

topple_dust.use: carriage split: long low cream dust cloud rolled out along a lost body's full length (30-stud box) when it lands after the topple (one per landing body)
topple_dust.canon: none: owner C11 topple (mission 260929-train-splits R12); proposed

glass_split.use: carriage split: the pane nearest the break on each wall smashes (mission variant of glass_burst: 23 bigger, longer-lived glinting shards on one emitter)
glass_split.canon: none: mission variant of glass_burst (av.vfx.glass) for the carriage split; proposed

interior_split.use: preview twin of split_explosion (identical layers) anchored inside the kept half for the interior (coach1p) tile; not exported, not wired
interior_split.canon: none: owner decision 2026-09-29 (C10 'I want a big explosion aswell') overrides the OQ-028 default for the carriage split only; proposed
